north_star: Choose the smallest context that preserves safe task completion, counting fixed instructions, rendering, verification, recovery, retries, and supervision.

research_roles.stale_constraints: motivates active verification allocation and run-level paired inference
research_roles.paritok_4b: motivates real-code compression evaluation and exact edit-context recovery
research_roles.jit_agent: requires model, task, host state, tools, and evaluator to stay fixed across context arms
research_roles.pilot: requires observer intervention and observer cost to be reported separately

dataset.name: SWE-bench Lite
dataset.source_context: Only the gold-patch-touched base-commit file is supplied, matching the Paritok within-file framing.
dataset.known_scope_limit: Target-file routing is pre-solved and task execution is not measured.

post_run_format_only_hashes.note: Prettier changed bytes after the single scored holdout run. No algorithm, threshold, task, or result was changed; frozen_hashes retain the exact executed bytes.

primary_metric.name: strict_retention_success
primary_metric.definition: The renderer stays inside its source budget, retains every exact issue line found in source, and retains at least one removed-line anchor from every gold patch hunk.
primary_metric.primary_curve: Mean across the seven compressed source budgets from 0.10 through 0.60.

acceptance_before_opening_holdout.exact_issue_evidence: 100 percent in every delivered ContextAdapt v3 cell
acceptance_before_opening_holdout.budget_monotonicity: zero task-level decreases in anchor, hunk, issue, or strict retention when budget increases
acceptance_before_opening_holdout.oracle_isolation: changing the evaluator-only patch changes zero non-oracle renderer outputs
acceptance_before_opening_holdout.holdout_primary: ContextAdapt v3 primary-curve strict retention exceeds both head-tail and lexical-intent; report clustered 95 percent intervals even if they cross zero
acceptance_before_opening_holdout.claim_ceiling: At most REAL_CODE_RETENTION_VALIDATED; never LIVE_TASK_QUALITY_VALIDATED or IMPROVED

negative_control.name: untrusted_same_file_traceback
negative_control.intervention: append one explicitly untrusted same-basename traceback pointing at line 1
negative_control.purpose: measure susceptibility of structural retrieval to plausible but misleading location hints
negative_control.acceptance: diagnostic only; regressions must be reported and motivate provenance-aware hint weighting

cost_boundary.fixed_problem: excluded from source allocation but included in all-in ratio
cost_boundary.prohibited_interpretation: These estimates are not provider tokens, 200K/400K/1M model calls, dollar savings, or task completion.
